Clozapine tablets in measured doses for retail sale are classified in heading 3004. Clozapine is a dibenzodiazepine derivative (a heterocyclic compound with nitrogen hetero-atoms only). Heading 3004.90 is "other" medicaments. The statistical suffixes for 3004.90.9210 and similar cover a range of items. The 3004.90.92 subheading is "Other: Other: Other", with 3004.90.9290 being "Other"? I recall CBP rulings on clozapine classifying it in 3004.90.9250 ("Other: Medicaments affecting the central nervous system"?). The 3004.90.92 breakdown includes: 10 Anesthetics...? I believe 3004.90.9210 is "Other: Other: Other: Antipsychotics/CNS"? From memory: 3004.90.9211 is "Drugs: Anti-infectives"? I can't confirm. The HTS list I recall is: 3004.90.92.10 Containing a nitrogen-hetero compound? Not sure. A common ruling on clozapine, such as NY N0xxxxx, gave 3004.90.9285? "Other: Psychotherapeutic agents"? Known HTS codes: 3004.90.9215 for antidepressants... 3004.90.9230 for antispasmodics... 3004.90.9250 for "Other: Central nervous system drugs"? I'll go with 3004.90.9250? I'm moderately unsure, but I think 3004.90.9235 is "Antipsychotics"? Hmm. I believe 3004.90.9240 covers "Psychotherapeutic agents", so I'll use 3004.90.9240? Weighing my recollections, 3004.90.9250 is better matched with "Other" CNS drugs. I'll go with 3004.90.9250.
